title: Carlos A. Godoy
vital_facts: Baptized 1977; Aaronic Priesthood 1977; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to Brazil Sao Paulo South Mission, 1981-83.
Married Monica Soares Brandao, 1984; Sao Paulo Brazil Temple; four children
Military service: One year in Brazilian army as a tank gunner.
Bachelor's degree in Economics and Political Science from Pontificia Universidade Catolica; Master's degree in Organizational Behavior from BYU.
Employment: Sales manager for Johnson & Johnson; Human Resources Manager for Otis Elevators; Human Resources Manager for Dow Corning Co.; Director at Sachs Automotive.
Branch President at Brazil Missionary Training Center; Region Welfare Agent; Young Men President; Elders Quorum President; High Councilor; Bishop; Area Seventy.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
